source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The comm port moves search change-reason constants from Ci.nsISearchService onto the existing SearchService receiver. It preserves the caller roles: ENTERPRISE for policy defaults, ADDON_INSTALL or ADDON_UNINSTALL for extension setting changes, and USER for preference selection. The extension control and prompt branches remain separate decisions. This is exact caller evidence; it does not prove an uninspected upstream enum, ABI or runtime result.
title: Search callers preserve change reasons when moving constants onto SearchService
